items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: '41. That's when I met Dizzy, and he took me up to Minton's.

ctx.x: '41. That's when I met Dizzy, and he took me up to Minton's. I used to go up there and play, sit in with them and play. But I really didn't start hanging out
